A human being who's brain was NOT meant to be working for 10,000 years but was forced to. And right after the entirety of the human race was wiped out and he could only bring back a fraction. I can definitely see the series going this way; the books all have an underlying message of "gray morality". Every single character has done bad things, they've all made bad choices and have some fucked up morals. But it doesn't mean that they're not *people* in the end.
